raw_text: Sikhs for Justice, a US-based pro-Khalistan group banned in India, has launched a renewed social media campaign ahead of planned referendums in multiple Western countries. Canada, the UK, and Australia have been identified as primary targets. Analysts note the campaign exhibits hallmarks of coordinated inauthentic behaviour, with bot networks inflating engagement metrics. India has formally raised concerns with the governments of host nations about allowing the events to proceed.
clean_text: BBC South Asia reported on SFJ's renewed referendum campaign across Western nations, noting coordinated inauthentic behaviour and bot network amplification. India raised formal concerns with host governments.
